thread:
Maria Chen: Heads up - we have two items for July close: unbilled hosted API usage for two trial customers and a pricing experiment that issued promo credits. Need guidance on accrual vs deferral and whether credits net against the accrual. Spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/close/1767
Tom Patel: Clarify: unbilled customer usage (should be accrued) and vendor pass-through? which one is outstanding?
Maria Chen: It's customer usage unbilled as of 7/31 (~estimated) plus one vendor pass-through invoice late by a week. Customer unbilled is the material one. Link to raw data: https://tiny.redwood/close/1767 (per-customer tab).
Alex Rivera: I ran the numbers from raw logs. Estimated gross unbilled revenue = $72,400 using July effective prices. Pricing experiment credits total $15,000. Draft JE:
```
DR 1300 Unbilled AR 72,400
CR 4000 Revenue - Usage 72,400
Memo: Accrual for unbilled July usage (gross)
```
Emma Stone: From rev rec perspective revenue earned in July, so accrue. But credits from experiment are downstream invoice adjustments. Should we net the credits in the accrual or record a contra-revenue when billed?
Maria Chen: Product says credits are invoice line-item adjustments and tied to experiment tag. Proposal: net credits now to reflect expected billing: net accrual = 57,400. I'll include experiment flag export as backup.
Tom Patel: Per policy, any accrual > $50k requires CFO approval. @CFO_Jess please confirm.
CFO_Jess: Methodology sounds fine. Need consolidated backup: per-customer breakout, experiment export with tags, and the math on one sheet. Send by EOD for sign-off.
Alex Rivera: Uploaded CFO_backup tab to the spreadsheet with per-customer lines and experiment IDs: https://tiny.redwood/close/1767#gid=2
finance-bot: Vendor invoice uploaded: vendor-invoice-9987.pdf (received 1767004000).
Emma Stone: I'll add a one-paragraph disclosure for auditors noting service delivery in July and that credits are expected invoice adjustments reducing billed revenue. Recommend netting for the accrual.
Maria Chen: Plan: Alex to post NetSuite journal tomorrow AM for net $57,400, Tom to route backup to CFO, Emma to add auditor note in close pack. Any objections?
Tom Patel: :thumbsup: no objections, will route.
CFO_Jess: Approved. After posting, tag close-pack PR #312 and I'll sign off.
__notes: Slack thread for month-end: accrual for unbilled customer usage impacted by pricing experiment credits. Includes short messages, JE code block, approvals and links.
